## What changed?

Describe the problem solved and the behavior changed.

## Validation

- [ ] Typecheck, lint, and formatting checks pass (or explain why not)
- [ ] Relevant unit/integration tests pass
- [ ] Dashboard/CLI/MCP behavior tested when changed
- [ ] Windows tested or platform limitations disclosed
- [ ] No real transcripts, tokens, credentials, or customer data included
- [ ] User-facing docs and capability matrix updated when needed
- [ ] No claim of native Grok Bot pruning, compaction, reset, or paid-usage savings without verified evidence
- [ ] Security-sensitive operations remain permission-gated

## Evidence

Include test commands and outcomes. Use synthetic test data only.

## Limitations / risks

List unresolved issues, breaking changes, external dependencies, and any unverified claims.
